rule: Each question was manually reviewed against its exact Notes.html anchor; only staged field replacements are recorded here.

fixes.explanation_en: Taiga, or boreal forest, is the vast cold subarctic forest biome of the Northern Hemisphere. It generally lies south of tundra and north of temperate forest.
fixes.explanation_te: Taiga లేదా Boreal Forest ఉత్తరార్ధగోళంలోని చల్లని ఉపఆర్కిటిక్ ప్రాంతంలో విస్తరించిన విశాల అటవీ జీవమండలం (Forest Biome). ఇది సాధారణంగా ఉత్తరాన Tundra, దక్షిణాన Temperate Forest మధ్య ఉంటుంది.
option_explanations_en: Correct: Taiga is the characteristic cold subarctic forest biome.
Equatorial rainforest is hot, humid and structurally different.
A hot desert core lacks the climate and tree cover of Taiga.
Mediterranean vegetation has dry summers and does not define Taiga.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది. Taiga చల్లని Subarctic Forest Biome.
Equatorial Rainforest వేడి, తేమగల వేరే Biome.
Hot Desert Coreలో Taiga వాతావరణం, Tree Cover ఉండవు.
Mediterranean Vegetationకు Dry Summers ఉంటాయి; Taigaను నిర్వచించదు.

reviews.evidence: Anchor p98-meaning directly defines the cold subarctic biome; key 1 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Across much of the Northern Hemisphere, Taiga forms a broad transition between treeless tundra to the north and temperate forest to the south. The boundaries are gradual ecotones, not sharp lines.
fixes.explanation_te: Northern Hemisphereలో Taiga సాధారణంగా ఉత్తరాన వృక్షరహిత Tundra, దక్షిణాన Temperate Forest మధ్య విస్తరించి ఉంటుంది. ఈ సరిహద్దులు కచ్చిత రేఖలు కాకుండా పరివర్తన మండలాలు (Ecotones).
option_explanations_en: Desert and savanna are lower-latitude dry biomes, not the Taiga neighbours.
Correct: Tundra lies broadly north and temperate forest south.
Mangroves and coral reefs are coastal tropical systems.
Steppe and Mediterranean scrub do not form Taiga’s standard north–south pair.
option_explanations_te: Desert, Savanna దిగువ అక్షాంశ Dry Biomes; Taiga సరిహద్దు జత కాదు.
సరైనది. సాధారణంగా Northలో Tundra, Southలో Temperate Forest ఉంటాయి.
Mangroves, Coral Reefs తీర ఉష్ణమండల వ్యవస్థలు.
Steppe, Mediterranean Scrub ప్రామాణిక Taiga North–South Pair కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p98-meaning anchor supports Tundra–Taiga–temperate sequence; key 2 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: The 55°–65°N belt is a useful exam approximation, not a universal boundary. Boreal limits shift with ocean currents, continentality, elevation, soils, fire history and the dataset used.
fixes.explanation_te: 55°–65°N మండలం పరీక్షకు ఉపయోగకరమైన సుమారు సూచన (Exam Approximation); సార్వత్రిక సరిహద్దు కాదు. Ocean Currents, Continentality, Elevation, Soils, Fire History, Datasetను బట్టి Boreal Boundary మారుతుంది.
option_explanations_en: Latitude bands are ecological guides, not political boundaries.
The boundary is not fixed at the same latitude everywhere.
Correct: it is an approximation modified by several environmental controls.
Taiga is predominantly a Northern Hemisphere biome.
option_explanations_te: Latitude Belts పర్యావరణ సూచనలు; Political Boundaries కాదు.
ప్రతి చోట ఒకే Latitude వద్ద Boundary ఉండదు.
సరైనది. అనేక Environmental Controls వల్ల మారే Approximation ఇది.
Taiga ప్రధానంగా Northern Hemisphere Biome.

reviews.evidence: p98-latitude anchor explicitly qualifies 55°–65°N; key 3 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: The core Taiga forms a broad circumpolar belt across Alaska, Canada, Scandinavia and Russia/Siberia. It is one of the world’s largest terrestrial biome belts.
fixes.explanation_te: ప్రధాన Taiga, Alaska, Canada, Scandinavia, Russia/Siberia అంతటా విస్తరించిన వలయాకార మండలం (Circumpolar Belt). ఇది ప్రపంచంలోని అతిపెద్ద Terrestrial Biome Beltsలో ఒకటి.
option_explanations_en: Amazon, Congo and Indonesia are tropical rainforest regions.
Sahara, Arabia and Thar are deserts.
Mountain conifers in the Andes, Alps and Himalayas are not the core circumpolar Taiga belt.
Correct: these northern regions contain the core Taiga distribution.
option_explanations_te: Amazon, Congo, Indonesia Tropical Rainforest Regions.
Sahara, Arabia, Thar Deserts.
Andes, Alps, Himalayas Mountain Conifers ప్రధాన Circumpolar Taiga Belt కాదు.
సరైనది. ఈ Northern Regionsలో Core Taiga విస్తరించింది.

reviews.evidence: Distribution anchor and map support option 4; key retained.

fixes.explanation_en: At latitudes equivalent to the Northern Hemisphere Taiga, the Southern Hemisphere has little continuous land. Oceans and Antarctica dominate, so no comparable circumpolar boreal forest belt can develop.
fixes.explanation_te: Northern Hemisphere Taigaకు సమానమైన Southern Hemisphere అధిక అక్షాంశాల్లో నిరంతర విస్తార భూభాగం చాలా తక్కువ. అక్కడ Oceans, Antarctica ఆధిక్యం వల్ల పోల్చదగిన Circumpolar Boreal Forest Belt ఏర్పడలేదు.
option_explanations_en: Correct: the lack of extensive high-latitude land is the main geographic reason.
Conifers can photosynthesise in the Southern Hemisphere where conditions permit.
The Southern Hemisphere does have winter.
Southern Hemisphere land is not all desert.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది. High-latitude Landmass కొరత ప్రధాన భౌగోళిక కారణం.
పరిస్థితులు అనుకూలిస్తే Southern Hemisphereలో Conifers Photosynthesis చేస్తాయి.
Southern Hemisphereలో Winter ఉంటుంది.
అక్కడి మొత్తం భూభాగం Desert కాదు.

reviews.evidence: Distribution concept is scientifically defensible; key 1 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Coniferous trees do not automatically make a forest Taiga. In Switzerland, conifers may form montane, subalpine or temperate conifer forests controlled mainly by elevation and local climate.
fixes.explanation_te: Coniferous Trees ఉన్న ప్రతి Forest Taiga కాదు. Switzerlandలో Elevation, Local Climate ప్రభావంతో Montane, Subalpine లేదా Temperate Conifer Forests ఏర్పడవచ్చు.
option_explanations_en: Conifer presence alone is insufficient to classify a biome as Taiga.
Correct: elevation-related and temperate conifer forests are distinct.
Latitude and climate remain important to biome classification.
Switzerland has extensive forest cover, including conifers.
option_explanations_te: Conifers ఉండటం ఒక్కటే Taiga Classificationకు సరిపోదు.
సరైనది. Elevation-related, Temperate Conifer Forests వేర్వేరు.
Biome Classificationలో Latitude, Climate ముఖ్యమే.
Switzerlandలో Conifersతో సహా Forest Cover ఉంది.

reviews.evidence: p98-not-all-conifers anchor directly makes this distinction; key 2 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Spruce, pine and fir are characteristic Taiga conifers. Their narrow needle-like leaves and conical forms help them tolerate cold, snow and a short growing season.
fixes.explanation_te: Spruce, Pine, Fir Taigaతో సాధారణంగా సంబంధం ఉన్న Conifers. వాటి సూదివంటి ఆకులు (Needle-like Leaves), శంఖాకార రూపం చలి, మంచు, చిన్న Growing Seasonను తట్టుకోవడానికి సహాయపడతాయి.
option_explanations_en: Teak, ebony and mahogany are mainly tropical forest trees.
Coconut, mangrove and date palm belong to tropical coastal or arid environments.
Correct: spruce, pine and fir are classic Taiga trees.
Olive, cork oak and grapevine are associated with Mediterranean climates.
option_explanations_te: Teak, Ebony, Mahogany ప్రధానంగా Tropical Forest Trees.
Coconut, Mangrove, Date Palm Tropical Coastal లేదా Arid Environmentsకు చెందుతాయి.
సరైనది. Spruce, Pine, Fir సాధారణ Taiga Trees.
Olive, Cork Oak, Grapevine Mediterranean Climateతో సంబంధం కలిగి ఉన్నాయి.

reviews.evidence: p98-vegetation anchor supports the tree group; key 3 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Larch is a conifer with needle-like leaves, but it sheds them seasonally. It is therefore a deciduous conifer and disproves the claim that every Taiga conifer is evergreen.
fixes.explanation_te: Larch సూదివంటి ఆకులు గల Conifer అయినప్పటికీ, ఋతువారీగా ఆకులు రాల్చుతుంది. అందువల్ల అది పతనశీల శంఖాకార వృక్షం (Deciduous Conifer); అన్ని Taiga Conifers Evergreen కావు.
option_explanations_en: Pine is generally needle-leaved, not a broadleaf explanation for the exception.
Taiga is a forest biome and contains many trees.
Evergreen means retaining leaves through seasons, not being annual.
Correct: larch is the decisive deciduous-conifer exception.
option_explanations_te: Pine సాధారణంగా Needle-leaved; ఈ Exceptionకు Broadleaf Explanation కాదు.
Taiga Forest Biome; చెట్లు ఉంటాయి.
Evergreen అంటే ఋతువులలో ఆకులు నిలుపుకోవడం; Annual Plant కాదు.
సరైనది. Larch ముఖ్యమైన Deciduous-conifer Exception.

reviews.evidence: p98-larch anchor explicitly supplies the exception; key 4 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Cold temperatures suppress evaporation, while frozen subsoil or poorly drained terrain slows downward and lateral drainage. Consequently, modest precipitation can still produce waterlogged Taiga soils and wetlands.
fixes.explanation_te: చలి వల్ల Evaporation తగ్గుతుంది; గడ్డకట్టిన Subsoil లేదా Poorly Drained Terrain నీరు కిందకు, పక్కకు వెళ్లడాన్ని అడ్డుకుంటాయి. అందువల్ల మితమైన వర్షపాతం ఉన్నా Taiga Soils నీటితో నిండి Wetlands ఏర్పడవచ్చు.
option_explanations_en: Correct: low evaporation and restricted drainage retain water.
Equatorial convection does not control Taiga waterlogging.
Taiga water does not come from ocean tides.
Organic matter may be present; its absence is not the main cause.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది. Low Evaporation, Restricted Drainage నీటిని నిలుపుతాయి.
Equatorial Convection Taiga Waterloggingను నియంత్రించదు.
Taiga నీరు Ocean Tides నుంచి రాదు.
Organic Matter ఉండవచ్చు; అది లేకపోవడం ప్రధాన కారణం కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p98-precipitation anchor directly explains waterlogging; key 1 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Taiga has a long, intensely cold winter and a short summer growing season. Although brief, that growing season is ecologically important for plant growth, breeding and food webs.
fixes.explanation_te: Taigaలో పొడవైన తీవ్రమైన శీతాకాలం, చిన్న Summer Growing Season ఉంటాయి. కాలం తక్కువైనా Plant Growth, Breeding, Food Websకు ఆ Growing Season చాలా ముఖ్యమైనది.
option_explanations_en: Taiga winters are long and cold, not short and warm.
Correct: this is the characteristic seasonal pattern.
Taiga has a large annual temperature range.
It is a subarctic continental climate, not a dry tropical monsoon.
option_explanations_te: Taiga Winters పొడవుగా, చల్లగా ఉంటాయి; Short Warm Winter కాదు.
సరైనది. ఇది Characteristic Seasonal Pattern.
Taigaలో Annual Temperature Range పెద్దది.
ఇది Subarctic Continental Climate; Dry Tropical Monsoon కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p98-climate anchor supports long winter and short growing season; key 2 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Wildfire and insect outbreaks are natural disturbance processes in Taiga. They alter forest age structure, regeneration, species composition and carbon balance, although climate change can modify their frequency and severity.
fixes.explanation_te: Wildfire, Insect Outbreaks Taigaలో సహజ అంతరాయ ప్రక్రియలు (Natural Disturbance Processes). ఇవి Forest Age Structure, Regeneration, Species Composition, Carbon Balanceను మార్చుతాయి; Climate Change వాటి Frequency, Severityని ప్రభావితం చేయవచ్చు.
option_explanations_en: Coral bleaching and tides are marine processes.
Glacier calving is a cryosphere process and not the principal Taiga disturbance pair.
Correct: fire and insects are major boreal disturbance agents.
Volcanic ash can affect forests locally but is not the standard recurring pair.
option_explanations_te: Coral Bleaching, Tides Marine Processes.
Glacier Calving Cryosphere Process; ప్రధాన Taiga Disturbance Pair కాదు.
సరైనది. Fire, Insects ప్రధాన Boreal Disturbance Agents.
Volcanic Ash స్థానిక ప్రభావం చూపవచ్చు; సాధారణ Recurrent Pair కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p98-disturbance anchor names both processes and effects; key 3 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Green shading on a biome map represents broad Taiga distribution. It does not imply identical forest density or a legal boundary; transition zones, or ecotones, occur along the margins.
fixes.explanation_te: Biome Mapలో Green Shading విస్తృత Taiga Distributionను సూచిస్తుంది. అది ప్రతి చోట ఒకే Forest Density లేదా Legal Boundaryని సూచించదు; అంచుల్లో పరివర్తన మండలాలు (Ecotones) ఉంటాయి.
option_explanations_en: Forest density varies within the shaded belt.
Biome shading is not a political boundary.
It is not an exact statutory forest limit.
Correct: it is a broad distribution sketch with transitional margins.
option_explanations_te: Shaded Beltలో Forest Density మారుతుంది.
Biome Shading Political Boundary కాదు.
ఇది Exact Statutory Forest Limit కాదు.
సరైనది. ఇది Transitional Marginsతో కూడిన Broad Distribution Sketch.

reviews.evidence: p98-map-reading anchor directly supports option 4; key retained.

main_findings: All twelve answer keys are supported by exact Notes.html anchors.
Generic explanation templates require replacement in every item.
The 55°–65°N belt remains an approximation rather than a universal ecological boundary.
Conifer presence alone is not treated as proof of Taiga; montane and temperate conifer forests remain distinct.
Climate, waterlogging, disturbance and map-reading explanations now teach the controlling processes.
